channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to archive.

summary_message_ts.desc: Timestamp of a message in the code channel to share back as a thread reply on the origin message. Requires the channel to have an `origin_link` set.

errors.already_archived: The channel has already been archived.
errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel\_id does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.no_origin_link: summary\_message\_ts was provided but the code channel has no origin\_link set.
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not a code channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.
errors.origin_channel_not_found: The origin channel referenced by the code channel is no longer accessible.
errors.origin_message_not_found: The origin message referenced by the code channel's origin\_link could not be found.
errors.restricted_action: The workspace does not allow the bot to archive channels.
errors.summary_message_not_found: The specified summary\_message\_ts does not correspond to a message in the code channel.
